message.content:
{
  "#cancel-request-title": "font-size: 22px; font-weight: 700; line-height: 1.5; color: var(--text); margin: 0; min-width: 0; word-break: keep-all; overflow-wrap: anywhere;",
  "#cancel-request-subject": "font-size: 16px; font-weight: 500; line-height: 1.5; color: var(--text); margin-top: 16px; word-break: keep-all; overflow-wrap: anywhere;",
  "#cancel-request-dialog>p:not([id])": "font-size: 14px; font-weight: 500; line-height: 1.5; color: var(--muted); margin-top: 8px; word-break: keep-all; overflow-wrap: anywhere;",
  "#cancel-request-error": "font-size: 16px; font-weight: 500; line-height: 1.5; color: var(--error); margin-top: 16px; word-break: keep-all; overflow-wrap: anywhere;",
  "#cancel-request-reload": "font-size: 16px; font-weight: 600; line-height: 1.5; min-height: 44px; padding: 12px 16px; border: 0; border-radius: 8px; background: var(--quiet); color: var(--text); margin-top: 12px; word-break: keep-all; overflow-wrap: anywhere;",
  ".request-cancel-actions": "display: flex; flex-direction: row; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 8px; margin-top: 24px;",
  "#keep-request,#confirm-cancel-request": "font-size: 16px; font-weight: 600; line-height: 1.5; min-height: 48px; padding: 12px; border: 0; border-radius: 8px; flex: 1 1 calc(4em + 24px); max-width: 100%; word-break: keep-all; overflow-wrap: anywhere;",
  "#keep-request": "background: var(--quiet); color: var(--text);",
  "#confirm-cancel-request": "background: var(--error); color: var(--surface);"
}
